    Execution & Planning

    Build an Execution Task List

    A 1-2 day system to solve 'we have insights but can't execute'

    1–2 days|Beginner|PR/Content/SEO/Dev/CS Collaboration
    Start Free AnalysisSee all workflows

    Contents

    Found improvement areas in HaloX dashboard but nothing changed by next week? Unclear how to hand off data? This workflow converts HaloX insights into 'tasks with owners, deadlines, and completion criteria.'

    What you'll get

    5 opportunity type classification (new content, rewrite, technical, authority, Quick Win)
    Task definition 6 elements (Owner, deadline, Priority, completion criteria, source, expected effect)
    3 essential Korea market tasks (source graph, review, Link Content)
    Task templates (copy-paste ready)

    Success Metrics

    Tasks completed per week5-10
    Task completion rate80%+
    Deadline overrun rateUnder 10%
    Simultaneous In ProgressMax 3 per team

    Step-by-step guide

    • SEO data — Check 11-20 range, Top 10 drops, ranking declines
    • GEO data — Check low citation rates, competitor surges, leaderboard bias
    • Opportunity analysis — Filter 'SEO-strong/AI-weak' and 'both weak' types
    • Site Audit — Check H1/Title/meta, schema, speed, 4xx errors
    • Field input — Reflect PR campaigns, regulatory changes, complaint surges, executive requests

    5 Opportunity Types and How to Handle Them

    TypeSignalAction
    Content (new)Visibility 0, no answer docCreate new reference hub
    Content (rewrite)Doc exists but not citedRestructure with Answer-first, tables, FAQs
    TechnicalSpeed, schema, 4xx issuesDev/publishing fixes
    Authority/sourceLeaderboard skewed to news/platformsPR distribution, reference standardization
    Quick WinLow effort, high impactAdd Title, H1, FAQ schema, summary box
    • Write 6-element task definitions — Owner, deadline, Priority, completion criteria, source, expected effect
    • Assign priorities — P0 (critical), P1 (high), P2 (medium), P3 (low)
    • Limit 'In Progress' to max 3 per team

    3 Essential Tasks for Korean Market Operations

    • •Source graph task (PR role exclusive) — Fix reference URLs for URL-possible channels, standardize page titles for others
    • •Review/compliance task (required for regulated industries) — Separate 'writing deadline' from 'review deadline', include reviewer designation from start
    • •Link Content connection task (essential for GEO measurement) — Register URL as Link Content in HaloX after publishing for before/after measurement

    Common questions

    We recommend max 3 'In Progress' per team. More parallel work exponentially increases review and communication costs.

    P0 is 4xx/blocking/unmeasurable (immediate), P1 is items that can immediately improve citation rate, P2 is mid-term impact, P3 is long-term experiments/ideas.

Authority/source	Leaderboard skewed to news/platforms	PR distribution, reference standardization
